description: Fix views, middleware, and context processor issues including error handling, authentication decorators, CSP headers, and database query optimization
steps: Review and enhance error handling in core/views.py error_400, error_404, error_500 functions
Audit all views for proper @staff_member_required and @superuser_required decorators on sensitive endpoints
Optimize core/context_processors.py to reduce database queries per request using proper caching
Tighten Content Security Policy in core/middleware.py SecurityHeadersMiddleware while maintaining functionality
Review core/backends.py EmailOrUsernameModelBackend for security best practices
Fix any N+1 query issues in model __str__ methods in core/models.py
Validate URL patterns in core/urls.py for security and proper routing
Add proper logging for security events and errors
acceptance_criteria: All error pages render correctly with proper status codes
Sensitive views require proper authentication and authorization
Context processor queries are optimized and cached appropriately
CSP headers allow necessary resources while blocking potential XSS
Authentication backend works securely with both username and email login
verification: Test error pages by accessing invalid URLs
Verify admin authentication works with both username and email
Check browser developer tools for CSP violations
findings: Views.py has basic error handling that may not cover all edge cases, context_processors.py makes multiple database queries that could benefit from caching, and middleware CSP policy may be too permissive for production security.
